title: GabberH0ProjectionRestrictions
statement: Let $X,Z,X\prime$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $i:Z\to X$ and $h:X\prime\to X$ morphisms, and $F$ a sheaf of sets on $X_{\rm et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let $t\in\Gamma(Z,i^{-1}F)$ and $s\prime\in\Gamma(X\prime,h^{-1}F)$, and suppose that on $Z\prime=Z\times_X X\prime$ the composite-inverse-image comparisons satisfy $c_{i,h_Z}(h_Z^*t)=c_{h,i\prime}(i\prime^*s\prime)$, transported along the fibre-product equation [def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Put $Y=X\prime\times_X X\prime$, $a=p_1h=p_2h$, $D=Z\times_X Y$, and $j:D\to Y$. For $G=a^{-1}F$, the two sections $c_{h,p_1}(p_1^*s\prime)$ and $c_{h,p_2}(p_2^*s\prime)$ of $G$ have equal images under the unit of $j^{-1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-finite-surjective-descent], where the second section is transported along $p_1h=p_2h$. This equality does not assert that the sections agree before restriction. No closed-immersion, finiteness or surjectivity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Construct q_1 and q_2 : Z ×_X (X′ ×_X X′) → Z ×_X X′ by pullback.lift. The pullback condition and associativity give their defining commutativity equations; pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd identify both projection composites.

Prove the section-level composition identity comparison_assoc by evaluating etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits: naturality in site objects moves the first fibre-product pasting map through the next unit, naturality in sheaves moves the first composition comparison through it, the associativity clause rewrites the composite of comparison morphisms, and the unit equation combines the two remaining units. Naturality of the last comparison moves the inverse pasting map across it. MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_assoc identifies the two triple pasting maps; pasting_transport supplies the cast along Category.assoc, map_transport eliminates the sheaf and object transports by equality induction, and the pasting isomorphism hom/inv equation cancels the last pair.

Turn hres into heterogeneous equality by equality induction on its eqToHom transport. Apply comparison_square, the fully proved generic consequence of comparison_assoc, to q_1 and q_2. Rewrite their two projection composites: both left sides become the same comparison applied to t, so transitivity identifies the two comparisons of s′ along j p_1 and j p_2. Apply restricted_comparisons: use comparison_assoc to return to the iterated comparisons, comparison_cast to account for p_2 h = p_1 h, and comparison_cancel to cancel the section maps of the comparison and pasting isomorphisms using ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso. This gives exactly the original equality under the raw unit along j.

mathlib_searches.query: Sections of etale inverse images of sheaves compatible with composition and fibre product projection pullbacks
The restrictions to the closed fibre of both projection pullbacks of a sheaf section are equal if the section lifts a fixed section on the closed subscheme

lean.statement: theorem gabber_h0_projection_restrictions {X Z X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (h : X' ⟶ X) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (t : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj F).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (s' : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback h).obj F).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (hres : etaleSetDescentComparison i (pullback.fst i h) F (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) t = eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : pullback i h ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := i) (g := h)).symm) (etaleSetDescentComparison h (pullback.snd i h) F (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s')) : let a : pullback h h ⟶ X := pullback.fst h h ≫ h let j : pullback i a ⟶ pullback h h := pullback.snd i a let G := (Scheme.etaleSetPullback a).obj F let U := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ a).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) etaleSetDescentUnit j G U (etaleSetDescentComparison h (pullback.fst h h) F (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s') = etaleSetDescentUnit j G U (eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : pullback h h ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := h) (g := h)).symm) (etaleSetDescentComparison h (pullback.snd h h) F (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s'))
